panels.description: Counts PRs raised in the window and assigned to the selected developers, split into Merged, Open, Closed, and Draft.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN pr.status = 'MERGED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Merged,
       SUM(CASE WHEN pr.status = 'OPEN'   THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Open,
       SUM(CASE WHEN pr.status = 'CLOSED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Closed,
       SUM(CASE WHEN pr.status = 'DRAFT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Draft
FROM pull_requests pr
WHERE pr.id LIKE 'github:%'
  AND $__timeFilter(pr.created_date)
  AND pr.base_repo_id IN ( ${repo_id} )
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_mapping pm
               WHERE pm.row_id = pr.base_repo_id
                 AND pm.`table` = 'repos'
                 AND pm.project_name IN ( ${project} ))
    AND pr.author_id IN ($developer_id)
ORDER BY (Merged + Open + Closed) DESC
LIMIT 20;

targets.rawSql:
-- Per repo, counts merged PRs that had no APPROVED review from anyone other than the author before the merge, and their share of all merged PRs.
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM pull_request_comments prc
        WHERE prc.pull_request_id = pr.id
          AND prc.type    = 'REVIEW'
          AND prc.status  = 'APPROVED'
          AND prc.account_id <> pr.author_id
          AND (pr.merged_date IS NULL OR prc.created_date <= pr.merged_date)
      ) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS 'Unapproved PRs'
FROM pull_requests pr
JOIN repos r    ON r.id = pr.base_repo_id
WHERE pr.status = 'MERGED'
  AND pr.id LIKE 'github:%'
  AND $__timeFilter(pr.created_date)
  AND pr.base_repo_id IN ( ${repo_id} )
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_mapping pm
               WHERE pm.row_id = pr.base_repo_id
                 AND pm.`table` = 'repos'

panels.description: Counts issues created in the window and assigned to the selected developers, split into Bug versus Tasks. Classification is keyword matching on the raw GitHub issue type/label text (original_type LIKE '%bug%'), not the connection's scope-config regex -- a repo whose labels don't literally contain "bug" (e.g. "defect") will show 0 here even though the issues exist.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  CASE WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(i.original_type,'')) LIKE '%bug%' THEN 'Bug' ELSE 'Tasks' END AS category,
  COUNT(*) AS issues
FROM issues i
JOIN board_issues bi    ON bi.issue_id = i.id
JOIN project_mapping pm ON pm.row_id = bi.board_id
                       AND pm.`table` = 'boards'
                       AND pm.project_name IN (${project})
WHERE i.id LIKE 'github:%'
  AND bi.board_id IN (${repo_id})
  AND $__timeFilter(i.created_date)
  AND (i.assignee_id IN ( $developer_id ) OR (i.assignee_id IS NULL AND 'unassigned' IN ( $developer_id )))
GROUP BY 1;

panels.description: Number of successful workflow runs / Number of total workflow runs

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  IF(result = '', 'Unknown', result) as result,
  count(distinct id) as build_count
FROM cicd_pipelines
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(finished_date)
  and id like "%github%"
  and cicd_scope_id in (${repo_id})
  -- the following condition will remove the month with incomplete data
  and finished_date >= DATE_ADD(DATE_ADD($__timeFrom(), INTERVAL -DAY($__timeFrom())+1 DAY), INTERVAL +1 MONTH)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 desc

panels.title: Total Workflow Runs Result Distribution

targets.rawSql:
select pr.title AS `Title`, pr.base_ref as `Release Branch`, pr.head_ref AS `Feature Branch`,   
REPLACE(
         COALESCE(
           NULLIF(TRIM(a.full_name), ''),
           NULLIF(TRIM(a.user_name), ''),
           NULLIF(TRIM(a.email),     ''),
           NULLIF(TRIM(pr.author_name),     ''),
           '(unmapped)'
         ), '-', ' ') AS Author,
         REPLACE(
         COALESCE(
           NULLIF(TRIM(a2.full_name), ''),
           NULLIF(TRIM(a2.user_name), ''),
           NULLIF(TRIM(a2.email),     ''),
           NULLIF(TRIM(pr.merged_by_name),     ''),
           '(unmapped)'
         ), '-', ' ') AS `Merged By`
from pull_requests pr
LEFT JOIN accounts a ON a.id = pr.author_id
LEFT JOIN accounts a2 ON a2.id = pr.merged_by_id
where pr.id in (
	select prc.pull_request_id from pull_request_commits prc 
	where prc.commit_sha  IN (
		select cpc.commit_sha 
		from cicd_pipeline_commits cpc
		WHERE exists (
			select 1 from cicd_pipelines cp 
			where cp.id = cpc.pipeline_id 
			and cp.result = 'FAILURE' 
      and cp.cicd_scope_id IN ( ${repo_id} )
		)
	)
)
Order by pr.created_date desc
limit 100;

panels.description: Lists up to 10 developers assigned more than 125% of the team's per-head average issue count (fair share) for issues created in the window, scoped to boards mapped to the selected project.

targets.rawSql:
Select replace(member, '-', ' ') as Developers, CONCAT(Tasks, ' / ', `Total Work`) AS `Issues Assigned / Total Issues`  from (
  WITH scoped AS (
  SELECT
    i.id,
    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(TRIM(a.full_name), ''),
      NULLIF(TRIM(a.user_name), ''),
      NULLIF(TRIM(a.email), ''),
      NULLIF(TRIM(i.assignee_name), '')
    ) AS member
  FROM issues i
  JOIN board_issues bi    ON bi.issue_id = i.id
  JOIN project_mapping pm ON pm.row_id = bi.board_id
                         AND pm.`table` = 'boards'
                         AND pm.project_name IN (${project})
  JOIN accounts a       ON a.id = i.assignee_id
  WHERE i.id LIKE 'github:%'
    AND bi.board_id IN (${repo_id})
    AND $__timeFilter(i.created_date)
),
per_member AS (
  SELECT member, COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS tasks
  FROM scoped
  WHERE member IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY member
),
totals AS (
  SELECT SUM(tasks) AS total_tasks, COUNT(*) AS headcount FROM per_member
)
SELECT
  p.member                                              AS `Member`,
  p.tasks                                               AS `Tasks`,
  t.total_tasks                                         AS `Total Work`,
  ROUND(t.total_tasks / t.headcount, 1)                 AS `Fair share`,
  ROUND(p.tasks - (t.total_tasks / t.headcount), 1)     AS `Deviation`,
  ROUND((p.tasks - (t.total_tasks / t.headcount))
        * 100.0 / NULLIF(t.total_tasks / t.headcount, 0), 0) AS `Pct vs fair`,
  CASE
    WHEN p.tasks > (t.total_tasks / t.headcount) * 1.25 THEN 'Overloaded'
    WHEN p.tasks < (t.total_tasks / t.headcount) * 0.75 THEN 'Underloaded'
    ELSE 'Balanced'
  END                                                   AS `Status`
FROM per_member p
CROSS JOIN totals t
ORDER BY p.tasks DESC
) base
where status = 'Overloaded'
limit 10;

list.definition:
WITH scoped_repos AS (
  SELECT r.id
  FROM repos r
  WHERE r.id LIKE 'github:%'
    AND r.deleted = 0
    AND r.id IN ( ${repo_id} )
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_mapping pm
                 WHERE pm.row_id  = r.id
                   AND pm.`table` = 'repos'
                   AND pm.project_name IN ( ${project} ))
),
scoped_accounts AS (
  -- PR authors
  SELECT pr.author_id AS account_id
  FROM pull_requests pr
  JOIN scoped_repos sr ON sr.id = pr.base_repo_id
  WHERE pr.author_id LIKE 'github:%'
  UNION
  -- reviewers and commenters
  SELECT cmt.account_id
  FROM pull_request_comments cmt
  JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.id = cmt.pull_request_id
  JOIN scoped_repos sr  ON sr.id = pr.base_repo_id
  WHERE cmt.account_id LIKE 'github:%'
  UNION
  -- issue assignees, scoped through boards (github board ids match repo ids)
  SELECT ia.assignee_id
  FROM issue_assignees ia
  JOIN board_issues bi ON bi.issue_id = ia.issue_id
  WHERE ia.assignee_id LIKE 'github:%'
    AND bi.board_id IN ( ${repo_id} )
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_mapping pm
                 WHERE pm.row_id  = bi.board_id
                   AND pm.`table` = 'boards'
                   AND pm.project_name IN ( ${project} ))
)
SELECT Name FROM (
  SELECT CONCAT(
           REPLACE(COALESCE(
             NULLIF(TRIM(a.full_name), ''),
             NULLIF(TRIM(a.user_name), ''),
             NULLIF(TRIM(a.email),     ''),
             '(unmapped)'
           ), '-', ' '),
           '--', a.id) AS Name
  FROM accounts a
  JOIN scoped_accounts sa ON sa.account_id = a.id
  GROUP BY Name
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Unassigned--unassigned'
) all_developers
ORDER BY Name
